unitTitle: An Early Bird or a Night Owl?
scanNote: Skanda oldingi o'quvchining qo'lyozma javoblari bor. 3-mashqda hammasi to'g'ri, lekin 1-mashqda TIZIMLI xato bor: u to'liq bo'lmagan soatlarga ham 'o'clock' qo'shgan ('half past eight o'clock'). Bundan tashqari 'in the night' (to'g'risi 'at night') va 'in the midnight' xatolari bor. Bu xatolar 'Ko'p uchraydigan xato' bo'limida saqlangan.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the key and write the times, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KALIT (kitobdagi izoh):
  am = ante meridiem  [tushdan OLDIN, 00:00–11:59]
  pm = post meridiem  [tushdan KEYIN, 12:00–23:59]

Bu LOTINCHA iboralar:
  ante = oldin, post = keyin, meridiem = tush payti

KUN QISMLARI:
  00:00–11:59 am → in the morning      (ertalab)
  12:00–17:59 pm → in the afternoon    (kunduzi)
  18:00–21:59 pm → in the evening      (kechqurun)
  22:00–23:59 pm → AT NIGHT            (kechasi)

DIQQAT — 'at night' ISTISNO:
  ✅ at night        ❌ in the night
  Boshqalari 'in the' bilan, faqat 'night' 'at' bilan.

UCH XIL VAQT:
  midnight  — yarim tun (00:00)
  noon / midday — tush payti (12:00)
  2:00 am   — ertalab soat 2 (yarim tun EMAS!)

commonMistake.whatUz: Skandagi oldingi o'quvchi 'half past eight O'CLOCK in the morning', 'quarter past nine O'CLOCK', 'four forty-five O'CLOCK' deb yozgan. Yana 'ten o'clock IN THE NIGHT' va 'two o'clock IN THE MIDNIGHT' deb yozgan.
commonMistake.whyUz:
UCH TIZIMLI XATO:
1) 'O'CLOCK' faqat TO'LIQ soatda ishlatiladi:
   ✅ eight o'clock (8:00)
   ❌ half past eight o'clock (8:30)
   ❌ quarter past nine o'clock (9:15)
   To'g'risi: 'half past eight', 'a quarter past nine'.

2) 'AT night' — 'in the night' EMAS. Bu istisno.

3) 'in the midnight' — bunday ibora YO'Q.
   'midnight' = 00:00. 2:00 am esa ERTALAB (in the morning).

items.answer: six o'clock in the morning
items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. To'liq soat → 'o'clock'. am → in the morning.

items.answer: six o'clock in the evening
ten o'clock at night
items.whyUz: 22:00 — kech. 'AT night' ('in the night' XATO!). To'liq soat → 'o'clock' bor.

items.answer: two o'clock in the morning
half past eight in the morning
a quarter past nine in the morning
a quarter to five in the morning
items.whyUz: 45 daqiqa → 'a quarter TO' va soat 4 dan 5 ga OSHADI. 'o'clock' yo'q.

items.answer: twenty past seven in the evening

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps in the chart below.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL IKKI USTUNLI — bir vaqtni IKKI XIL aytish:

  RAQAMLI usul     |  AN'ANAVIY usul
  eleven fifteen   |  a quarter past eleven
  two thirty       |  half past two
  seven fifty      |  ten to eight
  nine twenty      |  twenty past nine
  three forty-five |  a quarter to four

RAQAMLI usul juda oson — shunchaki raqamlarni o'qiysiz.
AN'ANAVIY usulda esa past/to qoidasi ishlaydi.

DIQQAT — 'to' bilan soat OSHADI:
  7:50 → ten to EIGHT (yetti emas, sakkiz!)
  3:45 → a quarter to FOUR (uch emas, to'rt!)

commonMistake.whatUz: Skandagi oldingi o'quvchi 3:45 uchun ikkala ustunga ham 'three forty-five' deb yozgan. Yana 'nine twenty' o'rniga 'nine tewnty' deb yozgan.
commonMistake.whyUz:
IKKI XATO:
1) An'anaviy ustunda 'a quarter to FOUR' bo'lishi kerak edi. Ikkala ustunga bir xil yozish — mashqning maqsadini yo'qotadi.
2) IMLO: 'twenty' — t-w-e-n-t-y ('tewnty' EMAS). Bu so'z juda ko'p ishlatiladi, imlosini mahkam eslab qoling.

items.answer: eleven fifteen / a quarter past eleven
two thirty
items.whyUz: An'anaviysi 'half past two'. Raqamli: soat + daqiqa.

items.answer: ten to eight
items.whyUz: 60 − 50 = 10 qoldi → 'ten TO'. Soat 7 dan 8 ga OSHADI.

items.answer: nine twenty
a quarter to four
items.whyUz: 60 − 45 = 15 = chorak qoldi → 'a quarter TO FOUR'. Soat 3 dan 4 ga oshadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Write the month before and the month after, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N IKKI OY TARTIBI:
  January → February → March → April → May → June →
  July → August → September → October → November → December

DIQQAT — hammasi KATTA harf bilan.
Mashqda kitob KATTA HARFLAR bilan yozgan (APRIL, MAY),
lekin oddiy matnda faqat birinchi harf katta bo'ladi: April, May.

DEKABRDAN KEYIN — yanvar (yangi yil boshlanadi).

items.answer: APRIL / JUNE
items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. May — 5-oy, oldingisi aprel (4), keyingisi iyun (6).

items.answer: OCTOBER / DECEMBER
JUNE / AUGUST
FEBRUARY / APRIL
AUGUST / OCTOBER

exercises.instructionEn: Look at Philip's daily routine and make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Filipning kundalik tartibiga qarang va namunadagidek gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
FILIPNING KUNI (soat sxemasi bo'yicha):

   7:00  get up          — turadi
   7:15  have a shower   — dush qabul qiladi
   7:30  have breakfast  — nonushta qiladi
   7:45  leave home      — uydan chiqadi
   8:00  catch the train — poyezdga chiqadi
   2:00  have lunch      — tushlik qiladi
   5:00  leave work      — ishdan chiqadi
   6:00  cook dinner     — kechki ovqat pishiradi
   8:00  watch TV        — televizor ko'radi
  10:30  go to bed       — yotadi

NAMUNA:
  Philip gets up at 7 am.

QOLIP:
  Philip + fe'l+S + AT + vaqt.

BARCHA FE'LLAR 3-SHAXS BIRLIKDA:
  get up → gets up,  have → has,  leave → leaves,
  catch → catches,   cook → cooks, watch → watches,
  go → goes

modelSentences.sentence: He has a shower at a quarter past seven.
modelSentences.uz: U yettidan chorak o'tganda dush qabul qiladi.

modelSentences.sentence: He has breakfast at half past seven.
He leaves home at a quarter to eight.
modelSentences.uz: U sakkizga chorak qolganda uydan chiqadi.

modelSentences.sentence: He catches the train at eight o'clock.
He has lunch at two o'clock.
He leaves work at five o'clock.
He cooks dinner at six o'clock.
modelSentences.uz: U soat oltida kechki ovqat pishiradi.

modelSentences.sentence: He watches TV at eight o'clock.
He goes to bed at half past ten.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
NAMUNA:
  SA: What time does Philip get up?
  SB: He gets up at seven o'clock.

DIQQAT — SAVOL VA JAVOBDA FE'L FARQ QILADI:
  Savolda:  does Philip GET UP    (-s YO'Q)
  Javobda:  He GETS UP            (-s BOR)

Chunki savolda '-s' allaqachon 'does' ichida bor.

QOLIP:
  SA: What time does Philip + fe'l (asos) ?
  SB: He + fe'l+S + at + vaqt.

items.question: What time does Philip get up?
items.answer: He gets up at seven o'clock.
items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. Savolda 'get up' (-s siz), javobda 'gets up' (-s bilan).

items.question: What time does Philip have a shower?
items.answer: He has a shower at a quarter past seven.

items.question: What time does Philip have breakfast?
items.answer: He has breakfast at half past seven.

items.question: What time does Philip leave home?
items.answer: He leaves home at a quarter to eight.
items.whyUz: 45 daqiqa → a quarter TO EIGHT (soat oshadi).

items.question: What time does Philip catch the train?
items.answer: He catches the train at eight o'clock.

items.question: What time does Philip have lunch?
items.answer: He has lunch at two o'clock.

items.question: What time does Philip leave work?
items.answer: He leaves work at five o'clock.

items.question: What time does Philip cook dinner?
items.answer: He cooks dinner at six o'clock.

items.question: What time does Philip watch TV?
items.answer: He watches TV at eight o'clock.

items.question: What time does Philip go to bed?
items.answer: He goes to bed at half past ten.

wordFormation.introUz: Workbook 20-bet — vaqt so'zlari va lotincha qisqartmalar.

groups.explanationUz: Ingliz tilida vaqt 12 soatlik tizimda aytiladi, shuning uchun am/pm kerak.
Uchtasi 'in the' bilan, bittasi 'at' bilan — bu ISTISNO.
Faqat TO'LIQ soatda. Daqiqa bo'lsa — ishlatilmaydi.
Bu oylarning yozilishi eng ko'p adashtiriladi.

patterns.formula: soat + o'clock + IN THE + kun qismi.
patterns.exampleEn: six o'clock in the morning / six o'clock in the evening
patterns.exampleUz: ertalab soat olti / kechqurun soat olti
patterns.explanationUz: To'liq soat uchun. Kun qismi 'in the' bilan — 'night' dan tashqari.

patterns.formula: half past / a quarter past / a quarter to + soat + IN THE + kun qismi.
patterns.exampleEn: half past eight in the morning / a quarter to five in the morning
patterns.exampleUz: ertalab sakkiz yarim / ertalab beshga chorak qolganda
patterns.explanationUz: 'o'clock' QO'SHILMAYDI — bu eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.

patterns.exampleEn: Philip gets up at 7 am. He leaves home at a quarter to eight.
patterns.exampleUz: Filip ertalab 7 da turadi. U sakkizga chorak qolganda uydan chiqadi.
patterns.explanationUz: Kundalik tartib — Present Simple. Soat bilan AT.

patterns.formula: What time does + ISM + fe'l (asos)? — He + fe'l+S + at + vaqt.
patterns.exampleEn: What time does Philip get up? — He gets up at seven o'clock.
patterns.exampleUz: Filip soat nechada turadi? — U soat yettida turadi.
